title: Laos PM vows justice for Australian backpacker deaths
summary: The people responsible for the deaths of two Australian backpackers will be brought to justice, Laos’ new prime minister has promised Australia after a backlash over the leniency of charges…

blocks.text: The people responsible for the deaths of two Australian backpackers will be brought to justice, Laos’ new prime minister has promised Australia after a backlash over the leniency of charges brought by prosecutors. Saleumxay Kommasith, who was sworn in as leader of the Southeast Asian nation in October, told Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese that authorities were reviewing the trial surrounding the deaths of Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles. The Melbourne teenagers died after a mass methanol poisoning at a backpackers hostel in Vang Vieng in November 2024.
